item.description:

I was afraid Richard Marx was going to play an hour like Cheap Trick in 2022. Rod Stewart was excellent. Before my friend got sick and moved away we were going to go to Chula Vista. I was even offered free tickets that week I had to decline. That one got canceled right before doors when Rod got sick so a slight twist might have had me missing this tour. Looks like this set is a tad longer than what he usually plays. He was very obviously having a great time. Between this and the 2 Rush shows I accumulated a lot of positive psychic energy to reflect upon this summer.

The Flower Of Scotland intro was actually a miniset by live bagpipes that I tried to capture. But they hit the stage while I was smoking a joint on the pavement walk to the far left. And then walking back a mic somehow slipped down the back of my shirt. Which I tried to fix at my seat leading to questions from the woman who sold me the ticket. I included some of it but things are a bit patchy til about 30 secs into the first song.

item.title: 【Live Audios (lossless)】FLAC - Rolling Stones + Samantha Fish @ Ridgedale, MO 2024-07-21
item.description:
Just a formality as I posted the raw files as soon as I got back to the hotel. Now there are multiple audio and video sources. This ranks up there among my all time great adventures that almost superceded the show itself so I was never in a hurry to play it thru. The Blu Ray with this audio is still up.

This show was an adventure the way I prefer to do it instead of a typical concert attendance (buy the tickets when they go on sale at surge pricing, ask for the time off then book the trip etc) as per usual I go rolling in ticketless and was pretty adamant that I would not be spending more than my already most expensive ticket of $268 for U2 which was also a few dollars less than the cheapest ticket for this event. Let's just say I met my goal and then some as I was wading thru all the shit and scammers on Facebook finding what was likely BassPro employees dumping their comp tickets for $50-100 though the online secondary market price was closer to face value. Ended up buying 14 and selling 12, hooking up the designated driver who flew with me on faith that tickets would be cheap and easily available by showtime. Lucky for him he also had a compatible wristband in his collection that got him into the pit. The irony here is I knew people who went to every single show except this one. Because it was too expensive.

One of the most beautiful venues I have ever been to. If I lived here I would just go to everything. Loved Branson too. I wish I could go back to the region for Gathering Of The Juggalos but I don't think I can pull that off.

Show itself was great. Keith seemed just a little emotional at the end which had me wondering if he already knew he wasn't going to commit to future tours. Only show with pyro? I really miss that from previous tours.

Still the last show to date
